candidates.title: From ‘killing the golden goose’ to better than ever: Has Alberta's relationship with Ottawa changed?
candidates.description: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith once said Ottawa "couldn't help" but be fixated on "punishing" the energy sector. Now, she says Canada is working better than it ever has. So what changed? And will it stick?
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Family of Quebec boy killed while cycling calls off ghost bike memorial, cites hate messages
candidates.description: The family of an 11-year-old boy who was fatally struck while riding his bicycle in Quebec City’s Beauport borough is calling off its plans to install a ghost bike in his honour this weekend, citing hateful messages they received.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: N.S. growers eye new apple export markets amid U.S. trade tensions
candidates.description: Nova Scotia's apple growers are finding international markets beyond the U.S., in a move to secure a better position amid trade tensions.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Body of P.E.I. man recovered months after fatal accident at Alberta oilsands site
candidates.description: Kenneth Joseph MacAulay, 66, of Souris, P.E.I., was working at Suncor Energy’s Fort Hills operation on Jan. 13, 2026, when the heavy equipment he was operating sank into the muskeg. The cause of the accident is still being investigated by the province.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Who's a good mayor? Kitimat adds 2 dogs to the ballot to boost voter turnout
candidates.description: With just 21 per cent of eligible voters casting ballots in the last municipal election, Kitimat is hoping two canine candidates can get more residents — including children — interested in voting.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Waymo is coming to Toronto. Will its self-driving cars be winter-ready?
candidates.description: Snow-covered objects can become hard to detect, while cameras and sensors sometimes struggle in snowy conditions. Experts say they're not insurmountable — but they will take more training data and time for Waymo to adjust to.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Union decries 'jaw-dropping' increase in violence against Winnipeg School Division staff
candidates.description: The union representing educational support staff in Manitoba's largest school division is sounding the alarm over what its president describes as a shocking increase in violence against its workers.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: High-profile legionnaire apologizes following profanity-laced outburst at Carbonear, N.L., wedding reception
candidates.description: A wedding reception at the Royal Canadian Legion branch in Carbonear ended earlier this month in an angry outburst after high-profile legionnaire and veteran Berkley Lawrence confronted the bride as she prepared to throw her wedding bouquet.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Charges stayed against 2 men in connection with fatal 2018 hit and run near Terrace, B.C.
candidates.description: Charges have been stayed against two men arrested in connection to a fatal hit and run near Terrace in northwest B.C. eight years ago.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: ‘Crypto King’ spent $16.3M of investor funds on cars, credit cards, jets, security, accountant testifies
candidates.description: Self-described “Crypto King” Aiden Pleterski spent nearly half of the $36.3 million investors gave him on himself and paid out about the same amount to investors as returns between 2020 and 2022, according to a senior forensic accountant who testified at his trial in Toronto’s Superior Court on Friday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: New Brunswick PCs get new leader today
candidates.description: Members will gather at the Fredericton Convention Centre to find out who will be the next leader of New Brunswick’s Progressive Conservative Party.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Jury hears forensic expert detail evidence in 30-year cold case sex assault trial
candidates.description: Investigators screened roughly 310 persons of interest over three decades before genetic genealogy tied Richard Neil to three southern Ontario park attacks.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Crown to seek dangerous offender status for Daniel Senecal, convicted of sexually assaulting toddler
candidates.description: The Crown Attorney's Office will seek a dangerous offender status for a registered sex offender who pleaded guilty in June to sexually assaulting a toddler in Welland, Ont., causing what were described as potentially life-threatening injuries.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Nova Scotia to host massive data centre to power Anthropic's AI assistant Claude
candidates.description: A massive data centre to provide computing power for artificial intelligence is under pre-construction just outside a town on Cape Breton Island, Nova Scotia.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Police release more details on fiery, fatal bus crash in Calgary
candidates.description: Calgary police are still investigating what led to a collision between two city buses and multiple other vehicles on Thursday, where a significant fire and explosion left three dead and 16 injured.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ottawa youth accused of anti-Jewish terror plot guilty of 2 of 3 charges
candidates.description: A young person charged as the alleged "co-conspirator" of a planned terrorist attack against Jewish people has been found guilty of committing a terrorist offence and facilitating a terrorist activity.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Toronto 18 ringleader no longer shows signs of extremism, granted full parole: board
candidates.description: Zakaria Amara, one of the ringleaders of the thwarted Toronto 18 terror plot, has been granted full parole after the Parole Board of Canada found he no longer showed "any signs of holding onto extremist beliefs or radical ideologies."
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Winnipeg zoo's newest orphaned polar bear cub now has a name: Mantayo
candidates.description: The first polar bear cub to arrive at Winnipeg's Assiniboine Park Zoo in nearly a decade now has a name.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: This West Bank teen feared he wouldn't survive the year. Now, he's dead
candidates.description: Omar Nassan was a student at a West Bank school where a gunman, later identified as an Israeli military reservist, opened fire this spring, killing two Palestinians. Half a year later, Omar himself died in a melee involving the Israeli Defence Forces.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Three Italian ‘hobbits’ flew to Ireland to return this man’s ring — and it was precious
candidates.description: Irishman Patrick Mohr thought his wedding ring was lost forever after it slipped off his finger into a fast-moving river in Italy. That is until three Italian strangers made it their mission to find it.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Zelenskyy urges support for new U.S. sanctions on Russia hours after Trump paused them
candidates.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged supporters on Saturday to speak out in defence of new U.S. sanctions against Russia, hours after President Donald Trump signed an executive order pausing a sweeping package of restrictions targeting the Russian economy.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Israeli settlers attack and beat Palestinians, U.S. journalist in West Bank
candidates.description: Washington Post photojournalist Heidi Levine says hardline Jewish settlers attacked her along with Palestinian olive farmers in the West Bank, and continued to kick her while she was on the ground. Settler violence has spiked since the start of the annual Palestinian olive harvest.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: White House press secretary Katie Zacharia leaving her role a week after starting it: official
candidates.description: U.S. President Donald Trump's press secretary Katie Zacharia is leaving her role a mere week after he put her in it, a White House official confirmed to CBC News.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians, American journalist during West Bank olive harvest
candidates.description: Dozens of masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians and injured an American journalist during olive harvesting in the occupied West Bank, according to witnesses and video footage. The Israeli army says the incident "will be examined."
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump pauses sanctions package targeted at Russian economy
candidates.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday signed an executive order that puts on hold a sweeping new sanctions package targeting the Russian economy, telling Congress the pause was in the national interest.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Teacher threw cellphone, tackled shooter who killed 4 at Oregon school, police say
candidates.description: A teacher threw her phone at the teenage gunman who killed four people at an Oregon elementary school , then tackled and fought with him — likely saving lives before he was shot by a father who followed him into the building, police said Friday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. Coast Guard rescues 16 people floating in the Pacific, including one with suspected shark bite
candidates.description: Sixteen people were rescued from the Pacific Ocean off Mexico's Baja California coast on Friday after the U.S. Coast Guard responded to a mayday call reporting a vessel was sinking. Another 11 people are believed to be missing.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Homes burn in Southern California amid fast-moving fire, prompting evacuation orders
candidates.description: A fast-moving fire fueled by high winds burned at least six homes in Southern California on Friday, engulfing expensive coastal properties and prompting thousands to evacuate.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: See the Amazon rainforest wildfires that have politicians pointing fingers amid Brazil presidential elections
candidates.description: Brazilian authorities are investigating whether a recent surge in wildfires in the Amazon rainforest have been set on purpose for political motives ahead of the second round of presidential elections later this months.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Saudi-hosted 2028 Olympics qualifier in BMX cycling cancelled after Riyadh airport bombing
candidates.description: A BMX cycling qualifying event in Saudi Arabia for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics was cancelled Friday after deadly missile attacks from neighbouring Yemen.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: EU debates Ukraine funding, as Zelenskyy's relations with the Trump administration ebb again
candidates.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy took aim on Friday at U.S. President Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia and welcomed the prospect of European allies stepping up their role in talks, calling Moscow's ‌stance a "parody" of peace negotiations.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 3 children, 1 teacher dead after shooting at Oregon elementary school, police say
candidates.description: A 16-year-old shooter opened fire on Thursday at an elementary school in Bend, Ore., killing four people, including three children, before being killed by an armed person ​who had pursued the assailant into the school, ​police said.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Israeli firm used ads to enable espionage, Canadian researchers say
candidates.description: An Israeli advertising agency has placed ads seen by millions of internet users that have left them open to spyware attacks, according to a new report from the University of Toronto's Citizen Lab.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Tesla unveils Roadster that can flip in the air and land using thrusters
candidates.description: Tesla has unveiled a redesigned Roadster powered with rocket-style thrusters and said it would start production in 2028, more than a decade after it first ‌showed a next-generation version of its electric sports car.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: New White House press secretary Katie Zacharia didn't pass the bar exam
candidates.description: New White House press secretary Katie Zacharia defended her legal background and justified her truncated inaugural briefing as she navigates a rocky first week as the president's chief spokeswoman.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canada courting Indian business partnerships in race to seal trade deal
candidates.description: Canada’s largest trade mission to India in 30 years has netted about 30 commercial partnerships worth $300 million, according to International Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Can AI be regulated? Why experts say government intervention is needed — but could be tricky
candidates.description: As concerns mount over incidents of AI agents going rogue, the push from experts and stakeholders have been growing for government regulation of AI systems that are becoming increasingly capable. But some experts say the need for global cooperation and how quickly AI is advancing could make that difficult.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Here's why some people say the 2-day weekend is due for a makeover
candidates.description: In October 1926, Henry Ford announced his factories would close not just on Sundays but Saturdays, too, making his company the first big North American employer to do so. But advocates for a shorter workweek say it’s time for an update to reflect both how we work and live today.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'In a perfect world,' federal government would nationalize Stelco, says Hamilton union leader
candidates.description: Stelco's Hamilton union president says he would support a federal government takeover of the steelmaker, which is implementing layoffs expected to cost hundreds of jobs.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: CREA revises down 2026 home sales forecast again as September transactions fall 7.7% over same month last year
candidates.description: The potential for rate hikes by the Bank of Canada and already-increasing fixed-rate mortgages are weighing on prospective buyers, according to CREA, leading the association to revise down its forecast for 2026. Those factors were already showing up in September, when home sales fell 7.7 per cent compared to the same month a year prior.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Teacher fought US school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
candidates.description: The 16-year-old suspect previously attended the primary school and had targeted a special educational needs classroom, police say.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
candidates.description: Brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were killed on a surfing trip in an apparent botched robbery.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
candidates.description: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Nursery owner in China jailed for life after hundreds of children poisoned
candidates.description: She and five staff members were found to have used the inedible paint in meals to make them look more appealing.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Rare pink diamond goes on display in France 100 years after amateur heist
candidates.description: The French royal jewel will be on public display for the first time since it was found hidden in an apple after a 1926 theft.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Katie Zacharia leaving White House role less than five days into job
candidates.description: Her public debut as press secretary ended with a flurry of media criticism about her credentials and preparedness.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Actress Selma Blair says she 'did not intend to harm anyone' in plane altercation
candidates.description: A publicist for the actress said the incident stemmed from a "medical emergency" and said she has a neurological disorder that can cause out-of-control responses.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Judge throws out child sex abuse charges against actor Timothy Busfield
candidates.description: The judge in the case said on Friday that the prosecutor "failed to act in a fair and impartial manner".
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Trump 'completely wrong' to restrict support for Ukraine, Italian minister tells BBC
candidates.description: Defence Minister Guido Crosetto tells the BBC the US risks prolonging Russia's full-scale invasion rather than helping to end it.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: The uncertain future of Canada's 30 rescued belugas
candidates.description: An international rescue operation for the last 30 captive whales in Canada made headlines. Then five of them died.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Toxic algorithms wouldn't let them go - now Australia wants an off switch
candidates.description: The Australian government hopes to protect social media users from being served content they don't want to see.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: A thousand slogans echoed here - but it could be the end for iconic Delhi protest site
candidates.description: Jantar Mantar, an 18th Century site almost synonymous with demonstrations in Delhi, has been denotified as a protest site.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Trial of German steakhouse heiress that sparked a huge spy scandal
candidates.description: For 15 months, a high-security courtroom in Hamburg has been hearing the case of Christina Block, accused of ordering the abduction of her children.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What we learned from heated US midterm Senate debates
candidates.description: As the 3 November election approaches and both parties fight for control of Congress, some clear themes have emerged.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back - with Starlink playing a key role
candidates.description: The BBC joins Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi as it regains crucial territory in the Donbas, but optimism has been dampened by souring relations with President Trump.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Watch: Did Tesla really just unveil a flying car?
candidates.description: Tesla CEO Elon Musk showcased the vehicle at a facility owned by his SpaceX company, which helped develop the model.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'It's really hard to believe' - How Oregon primary school shooting unfolded
candidates.description: Three children aged 5, 8 and 11 and a teacher were killed after a 16-year-old suspect opened fire in the city of Bend, local police say.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Russian man linked to deadly London hospitals hack arrested
candidates.description: The 28-year-old detained by German police is accused of being part of the cyber-crime gang that hacked blood-test firm Synnovis in 2024.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Why hasn't the UK had any named storms yet?
candidates.description: So far this autumn wet and windy weather patterns have been steered away from the UK. When could we see that change?
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Fast-moving California wildfire burns homes as people are ordered to leave
candidates.description: Fanned by the fierce Santa Ana winds, the Norte Fire is one of 13 burning across the state.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Scuffles and fires break out as protesters rally across France, joining students
candidates.description: Demonstrators across France converged with students Saturday to protest rising living costs, as the country's fiscal crisis deepens.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital days after lung cancer surgery
candidates.description: The Pope left Rome's Gemelli Hospital Saturday, days after surgery for lung cancer removed the lower lobe of his right lung. He is currently scheduled to travel to Latin America in November.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Zelenskyy urges support for new US sanctions on Russia after Trump puts them on hold
candidates.description: Zelenskyy described the move as unfortunate, adding it would encourage Russia to continue its assault. Trump told Congress that the pause was in the national interest but gave no further details.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Decades after apartheid, South Africans seek justice for crimes of the past
candidates.description: More than three decades after the end of apartheid, families of victims of some of the worst crimes of South Africa's past are still fighting for justice. As survivors and perpetrators grow older, a new wave of legal efforts is seeking truth, accountability and reparations before it's too late.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
candidates.description: Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Israeli settlers beat Palestinians and a U.S. photojournalist in West Bank attacks
candidates.description: Masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians as they were harvesting olives in the occupied West Bank on Friday, injuring several people including a photojournalist working for The Washington Post .
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Crowds throng New Delhi and wave Indian flags amid escalating protests
candidates.description: Protests have intensified over a review of voter lists that critics say is politically motivated and threatens to disenfranchise voters. The Election Commission and Modi's administration deny these allegations.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Sally Rooney's books will no longer be sold in U.K. after support for pro-Palestinian group
candidates.description: The Irish author said her books can no longer be sold in the UK after she pledged the royalties to a banned pro-Palestinian group.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Russia's view amid Ukraine's strikes and Zelenskyy's growing rift with the U.S.
candidates.description: Russian authorities say Ukraine struck a major oil refinery southeast of Moscow Thursday. The strike was in response to Russia's attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: How Putin may react to the rift between the U.S. and Ukraine
candidates.description: Journalist and Russia analyst Julia Ioffe lays out how Vladimir Putin might be trying to exploit the current divide between the U.S. and Ukraine over striking Russian oil refineries.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Weddings are expensive. How about a grocery store cake?
candidates.description: About a third of couples are willing to save money on cake and dessert, according to the wedding-planning site Zola.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: What this bankruptcy says about AI startups
candidates.description: Character.AI collected millions of users, making it a very appealing acquisition. Google took a unique route to "acquiring" it, hiring away its founders and licensing its technology. Now Character.AI is filing for bankruptcy. Here's what to know.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Hot flashes, night sweats, insomnia – OB-GYNS set new rules for menopause treatment
candidates.description: For the first time since 2014, the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists has updated its guidelines for the treatment of symptoms commonly associated with menopause.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Public health nurse talks about the moment she learned to ask for help
candidates.description: For StoryCorps, a public health nurse in Minnesota speaks with her college mentor about a moment when she almost gave up on her career aspirations.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Hit a midlife wall? Here's how to rediscover your strengths
candidates.description: Health and science correspondent Allison Aubrey talks with Ailsa Chang about her new podcast Your Turn with Allison Aubrey — and they share a survey that can help us identify our most positive character traits.
candidates.author: NPR
